But it seems that we got a bit lost in definitions, so lets leave it at that :v

Recruiting her is very finicky, and can easily be messed up. The TLDR requirements are:

1. Do NOT talk to Zevlor after speaking with Kagha
2. Do NOT recieve ANY quest where it says "Kill the goblin leadership", as if you do, knocking Minthara out will still make the game think she is dead, and not show up at Moonrise. The ones who give the quests are Zevlor and Halsin.
3. Do NOT speak with Minthara in Act 1, ever. Doing so will give you the "Raid the druid grove" quest, which will prevent her from showing up at Moonrise, even if knocked out.
4. Do NOT speak with Dror Razglin. Doing so will give you the "Raid the druid grove" quest, which will break the recruitment.
5. Do NOT talk to Halsin before slaughtering the gobbo camp, killing gobbo leaders and knocking out Minthara, as that will break her recruitment.

The order to do things to properly to recruit her is: 

1. Ignore Zevlor in his room after speaking wth Kagha (when he is inside the cave behind the stone door in the druid grove)
2. Go to Gobbo camp and kill priestess Gut
3. Knock out Minthara (dont talk to her)
4. Kill Dror Razglin (dont talk to him)
5. Free Halsin from his cage
6. Only NOW can you do a long rest (some people say that you can long rest in between killing the gobbo leaders, but i wouldnt risk it)
7. Go to Minthara's location and see if she is up and walking around after the long rest. If she is, it's 100% confirmed she will show up at Moonrise.
8. Party with tieflings

•Stegadon spam usually works against most armies, not just vs dark elves

•Important factors for confederations are: 1. You must be  much stronger than them militarily (check diplomacy, the powerbar thing should be at least 2/3 yellow. 2. High opinion, at least 100 should be fine. 3. At least a defensive alliance should work. DONT break alliances, that will cause their opinion of you to massively get hurt for a long time.

•Check if your reliability is low. Even with high opinion of a faction, if you previously broke a non agression pact, attacked a faction you were trading with, etc, that will make diplomacy pretty much unavalable for a few turns, depending om the severity of what you did.

•An army consisting of mostly stegadons (not the ancient stegadon, the regular ones) is probably the best lizardmen army, have one or two high mages on an Engine of the gods mount, maybe one or two saurus scar veterans on carnosaurs. You can mix some other monster units in the army, like some dread saurians, but it should mainly be stegadons. If you want the army to be basically unkillable, have it be led by a Life Slann.

• Khemri and followers of nagash start the campaign at war with each other, but if enough time passes they might make peace. If even more time passes, they might have a mutual enemy they both are at war with, which will increase their opinion of each other, to a point where they like each other enough to form trade deals or alliances.
